name: Paperclip (Official Image)

upstream.$note: Official image; tag 2026.916.1 == :latest digest sha256:a02ac35a... on 2026-09-26. Entrypoint already chowns root-owned Railway volumes.

workspaces.$note: Auromations Stripe subscription UNPAID on 2026-09-26 blocked projectCreate ('Your trial has expired'). templateUpsertConfig accepts any workspaceId, so only the template lives in Auromations.

$note: exposure=private (image default) on purpose: Haseeb chose the browser 'Claim this instance' UX (POST /api/bootstrap/claim, first signed-in user becomes instance admin) over public mode's one-time CLI invite. Tradeoff: unclaimed window on a public URL; listing tells deployers to claim immediately.
The public-mode variant (bootstrap-ceo via tsx in /app/cli + printenv'd CLI config in a start command) was built and passed 10/10 on 2026-09-28; see git history if ever wanted.
PAPERCLIP_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=true: private mode defaults it off.
No start command: image ENTRYPOINT (tini + docker-entrypoint.sh, chowns root-owned volume, gosu node) runs as-is.
HOST=:: was ignored (banner: bind lan 0.0.0.0) and the edge reaches 0.0.0.0 fine, so no HOST override.

verified.journey: test/journey.sh 11/11 on fresh stranger deploy; UI walk: setup screen -> create account -> Claim this instance -> onboarding
